newsitem.headline: OFFICIAL JOURNAL CONTENTS - OJ L 341 OF DECEMBER 30, 1996.

text.p: COUNCIL REGULATION (EC) No 2484/96 of 20 December 1996 amending the Annex to Regulation (EC) No 1255/96 temporarily suspending the autonomous Common Customs Tariff duties on certain industrial and agricultural products END OF DOCUMENT.
